lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh doojai bharam bhulaae naa boojhahi veechaaraa ||7||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander, lost in doubt and duality. They do not know how to contemplate the Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape guramukh aape devai aape kar kar vekhai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself gives; He Himself creates and beholds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak se jan thaai pae hai jin kee pat paavai lekhai ||8||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings are approved, whose honor the Lord Himself accepts. ||8||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਸਾਈਁ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gusaaee(n) parataap tuhaaro deethaa ||
lines.translation: O Lord of the World, I gaze upon Your wondrous glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਬੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan upaai samaavan sagal chhatrapat beethaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Creator and Destroyer. You are the Sovereign Lord of all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਣਾ ਰਾਉ ਰਾਜ ਭਏ ਰੰਕਾ ਉਨਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: raanaa raau raaj bhae ra(n)kaa un jhoothe kahan kahaaio ||
lines.translation: The rulers and nobles and kings shall become beggars. Their ostentatious shows are false

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hamaraa raajan sadaa salaamat taa ko sagal ghataa jas gaaio ||1||
lines.translation: . My Sovereign Lord King is eternally stable. His Praises are sung in every heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਮਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਹਤ ਜੇਤ ਪਾਹੂਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: upamaa sunahu raajan kee sa(n)tahu kahat jet paahoochaa ||
lines.translation: Listen to the Praises of my Lord King, O Saints. I chant them as best I can.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਊਚੇ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: besumaar vad saah daataaraa ooche hee te oochaa ||2||
lines.translation: My Lord King, the Great Giver, is Immeasurable. He is the Highest of the high. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਨਿ ਪਰੋਇਓ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰਾ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾਸਟ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pavan paroio sagal akaaraa paavak kaasat sa(n)ge ||
lines.translation: He has strung His Breath throughout the creation; He locked the fire in the wood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਰੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਏਕਤ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: neer dharan kar raakhe ekat koi na kis hee sa(n)ge ||3||
lines.translation: He placed the water and the land together, but neither blends with the other. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਥਾ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat kathaa raajan kee chaalai ghar ghar tujhahi umaahaa ||
lines.translation: In each and every heart, the Story of our Sovereign Lord is told; in each and every home, they yearn for Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh paachhai kariaa prathame rijak samaahaa ||4||
lines.translation: Afterwards, He created all beings and creatures; but first, He provided them with sustenance. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣਾ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਨੑੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karanaa s aape karanaa masalat kaahoo deenhee ||
lines.translation: Whatever He does, He does by Himself. Who has ever given Him advice?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਚੀਨੑੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar karah dikhaae saachee saakhee cheenhee ||5||
lines.translation: The mortals make all sorts of efforts and showy displays, but He is realized only through the Teachings of Truth. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਦੀਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagataa kar raakhe apane deenee naam vadaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord protects and saves His devotees; He blesses them with the glory of His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਤੇ ਤੈਂ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜੑਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jin jin karee avagiaa jan kee te tai(n) deee ruRhaaee ||6||
lines.translation: Whoever is disrespectful to the humble servant of the Lord, shall be swept away and destroyed. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਅਵਗਨ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat bhae saadhasa(n)gat kar tin ke avagan sabh parahariaa ||
lines.translation: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are liberated; all their demerits are taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tin kau dekh bhae kirapaalaa tin bhav saagar tariaa ||7||
lines.translation: Seeing them, God becomes merciful; they are carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਾਨੑੇ ਨੀਚ ਤੁਮੑੇ ਬਡ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham naanhe neech tumhe bad saahib kudarat kaun beechaaraa ||
lines.translation: I am lowly, I am nothing at all; You are my Great Lord and Master - how can I even contemplate Your creative potency?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man tan seetal gur daras dekhe naanak naam adhaaraa ||8||1||
lines.translation: My mind and body are cooled and soothed, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Nanak takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 asatapadee ghar 6 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Sixth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agaadh sunahu jan kathaa ||
lines.translation: Listen to the Story of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਸਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham kee acharaj sabhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The glory of the Supreme Lord God is wondrous and amazing! ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa satigur namasakaar ||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, humbly bow to the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te gun gaai apaar ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bheetar hovai paragaas ||
lines.translation: His Light shall radiate deep within your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: giaan a(n)jan agiaan binaas ||1||
lines.translation: With the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, ignorance is dispelled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mit naahee jaa kaa bisathaar ||
lines.translation: There is no limit to His Expanse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sobhaa taa kee apar apaar ||
lines.translation: His Glory is Infinite and Endless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik ra(n)g jaa ke gane na jaahi ||
lines.translation: His many plays cannot be counted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sog harakh duhahoo mahi naahi ||2||
lines.translation: He is not subject to pleasure or pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬੇਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik brahame jaa ke bed dhun karahi ||
lines.translation: Many Brahmas vibrate Him in the Vedas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਹੇਸ ਬੈਸਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik mahes bais dhiaan dharahi ||
lines.translation: Many Shivas sit in deep meditation.
